title.title: The Correspondence of Esther Roberts Hunt Collins

msIdentifier.institution: Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College

projectDesc.p: The correspondence of Quaker minister Rebecca Jones is stored at the Friends Historical Library of Swarthmore College. With the generous support of H. David and Joyce E. Hunt, Library staff scanned and transcribed these letters in 2024 and encoded the text in TEI.

body.p: I write in great haste, to mention the request of one of my near Friends, Hannah Brooke, wife of my landlord Bayer Brooke, who is in the neighborhood of Jonathan Knight, and at the house of a Joseph Green near the Red Lion she is in a state truly pitiable, owing to deep exercise of mind, & believes the door of mercy is shut upon her. (I believe otherwise, having been an innocent creature from a child) she is very desirous of seeing thee, and I do hope thou mayest be made instrumental in the Lord’s hand–to comfort, & raise her drooping mind out of the horrible pit. So do comply is thou canst & give me a line afterwards. I have but a minute or two to write, so excuse haste. My love to thy precious Hannah, also to dear James & Hannah Thornton when thou seest them, they have my tender sympathy.
body.closer: I am with sisterly affection thy friend, R Jones Philadelphia 7mo 2nd 1794
